forms.label: Freshly juiced
forms.sourceNote: Nutrition and sugar are the FNDDS record for pineapple juice, 100% (2709329), which has no density of its own. Density is the SR Legacy canned-and-bottled record's own liquid measure, 1.0584 g/ml (168187), adopted because juice is poured rather than packed; the two records' sugar figures agree. Both public domain. No acid figure is carried: pineapple's titratable acidity falls outside the site's lemon/lime/vinegar convention and no other source was checked, so acidPercent is left off rather than estimated.
